items.title: Does Paychex (PAYX) Deserve A Discount After Its 22% Slide?
items.summary: Paychex shares have slid sharply in recent weeks, and the drop raises a straightforward question for anyone looking at the stock today. Do the company’s underlying cash flows justify where the market is now pricing the business after this pullback? items.title: Paychex Just Fell 14%. How Does Its Dividend Stack Up Against ADP?
items.summary: Paychex just handed income investors a yield nearly double what ADP offers, but a 14% selloff and a balance sheet carrying billions in acquisition debt raise questions about whether that payout is a bargain or a warning sign.

items.title: Before You Buy Paychex Stock, Settle This
items.summary: Paychex's largest business, Management Solutions, grew more slowly in the first quarter than management expected. That line brings in most of the company's revenue, so a lasting shortfall would slow all of Paychex (PAYX). Management says the shortfall is mostly revenue moving to another part of Paychex, but it has not said how much moved.

items.title: 3 Software Stocks We’re Skeptical Of
items.summary: Software is eating the world, and virtually no business is left untouched by it. The undeniable tailwinds fueling the industry have also led to strong returns for SaaS stocks lately as they’ve gained 47.2% over the past six months, outpacing the S&P 500’s 21.4% rise.

items.title: These 4 Dividend Stocks Turn Customer Loyalty Into Growing Income
items.summary: Some businesses are so deeply embedded in daily operations that customers rarely bother to leave, and four companies have quietly built their dividends on exactly that kind of inertia. The question is whether sticky revenue alone is enough to keep payouts growing when the economy turns.
